description:
We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is an exceptional opportunity for a visionary nursing leader to make a significant impact on patient care and staff development.

The Director of Nursing will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, and maintaining compliance with all regulatory requirements. You will play a crucial role in fostering a positive and supportive environment for both residents and staff.

This full-time position offers a competitive annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, reflecting your expertise and commitment to excellence.
requirements: Valid Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience as a Director of Nursing or in a similar nursing leadership role
Proven experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care environment
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.
